e.title: **一个**把**智利金融监管机构**（CMF）**几乎全部公开数据**做成 **MCP 服务器**的**开源项目****：`mcp-cmf-chile`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**；**⭐ 两种暴露方式实测**：**经典模式 **88 个工具**、**定义**约 **37,000 tokens／请求****，**代码模式 **2 个工具**、**固定约 **736 tokens****（**⭐ 自述**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos**」**）**；**⭐ 一条硬规则逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**；**⭐ 覆盖逐字含**「**registro de depósito de pólizas**」**（**保单**存放登记**）**；**⭐ 许可逐字 **MIT****；**⭐ 法律声明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**
e.title_en: An open-source project that turns almost all public data of the Chilean financial market regulator into a model context protocol server: it states in writing that it implements the protocol specification with dual-era support including the legacy initialisation handshake, exposes the same eighty-eight operations in two measured ways where the classic mode carries about thirty-seven thousand tokens of tool definitions per request and the code mode holds a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens for a ninety-eight percent reduction, adopts a hard rule that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen, covers the policy deposit registry among its domains, carries an MIT licence, and states in writing that it is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the regulator.
e.title_hk: **一個**把**智利金融監管機構**（CMF）**幾乎全部公開數據**做成 **MCP 伺服器**的**開源項目****：`mcp-cmf-chile`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**；**⭐ 兩種暴露方式實測**：**經典模式 88 個工具**、**定義**約 **37,000 tokens／請求****，**代碼模式 2 個工具**、**固定約 **736 tokens****（**⭐ 自述**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos**」**）**；**⭐ 一條硬規則逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**；**⭐ 覆蓋逐字含**「**registro de depósito de pólizas**」**；**⭐ 許可逐字 MIT****；**⭐ 法律聲明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**
e.summary: **MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一个**把**智利金融市场委员会**（CMF）**公开数据**接给 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 星标 **2****、**创建 **2026-08-08****、**最后推送 **2026-09-11****、**仓库 **2 MB****、**主语言 **TypeScript****、**许可证逐字 **MIT****、**默认分支 **`master`****；**⭐ README **14,192 字节**／**272 行****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**——**⭐ 本轮**不**用英语词**，**而**用**西／葡／德／土／意／日／韩／中八种语言的**保险词**检索 **GitHub**，**本条**是**其中**西班牙语一路的**结果**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **同一批 **88 个操作**，**两种暴露方式**的**令牌成本实测**（**37,000** 对 **736**）**——**⭐ 即**「**工具数量**」**本身就是**上下文预算**，**而**这**在**保险这类**字段极多**的**领域**尤其致命**；**② **一条硬规则逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**（**工具**永不**替代理决定**哪一部分数据**值得看）**——**⭐ 即**过滤**交给**调用方的**代码**，**而**不**交给**工具**；**③ **它**指名**修掉的**一个真实缺陷**：**经典模式的**文本摘要**不**含 **`url` 列****，**于是**代理**可能**找到了**一张保单**、**却**永远**读不到**它****（**⭐ 因为**模型**只**看得到**文本块**，**`structuredContent`** 只**对**程序调用方**存活**）**；**④ **法律声明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**——**⭐ 即**「**用**监管机构的**公开数据**」**与**「**代表**监管机构**」**是**两件事**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未连接**该服务器**。
e.summary_hk: **MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一個**把**智利金融市場委員會**（CMF）**公開數據**接給 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 伺服器****——**逐字自述為**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 星標 2**、**創建 2026-08-08**、**最後推送 2026-09-11**、**倉庫 2 MB**、**主語言 TypeScript**、**許可證逐字 MIT**、**默認分支 `master`**；**⭐ README 14,192 位元組／272 行**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**——**本輪**用**西／葡／德／土／意／日／韓／中八種語言的保險詞**檢索 **GitHub**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **同一批 88 個操作**、**兩種暴露方式**的**令牌成本實測**（**37,000** 對 **736**）**——**⭐ 即**工具數量**本身就是**上下文預算**；**② **硬規則逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**；**③ **它指名修掉的真實缺陷**：**經典模式的文本摘要不含 `url` 列****，**代理**可能找到**一張保單**、**卻永遠讀不到它**（**模型只看得到文本塊**，**`structuredContent`** 只對程序調用方存活**）**；**④ **法律聲明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未連接**該伺服器**。
e.summary_en: This is a model context protocol server that connects artificial-intelligence agents to the public data of the Chilean financial market regulator, describing itself in writing as a model context protocol server. **Measured this round**: two stars, created on the eighth of August and last pushed on the eleventh of September, a repository of about two megabytes in TypeScript, an MIT licence, and a default branch named master, with a description of about fourteen kilobytes over two hundred seventy-two lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language**, since this round searched a code host with insurance words in Spanish, Portuguese, German, Turkish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese instead of English, and this is the Spanish-language result. **Four things are worth reading: the same eighty-eight operations are exposed in two ways whose token cost is measured, roughly thirty-seven thousand tokens of tool definitions per request in the classic mode against a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens in the code mode, which shows that the number of tools is itself a context budget and that this matters most in a domain with as many fields as insurance; a hard rule states in writing that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen, so filtering belongs to the caller code rather than to the tool; the project names the real defect it fixed, namely that the classic mode text summary carried no url column, so an agent could find a policy document and never be able to read it, because the text block is the only part of a protocol response a model sees while structured content survives only for programmatic callers; and the legal notice states in writing that the project is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the regulator, which is the distinction between using an authority open data and speaking for it.** **The server was neither installed nor connected this round.**
e.body:
**MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一个**把**智利金融市场委员会**（CMF）**公开数据**接给 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一批操作，两种暴露方式，令牌成本被实测出来****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**两条端点**：**经典模式**「**88 herramientas, una por operación**」**，**其**定义**逐字**「**unos 37 mil tokens medidos**」**；**代码模式**「**2 herramientas**」**，**逐字**「**un costo fijo de unos 736 tokens**」**，**并逐字总结**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos, y no crece si mañana hay 200 operaciones.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本轮**最值得**抄下来**的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**把工具数量当上下文预算**」**——**⭐ 在**保险这类**字段极多**的**领域**（**保单、**批单、**准备金、**科目）**，**一个**领域接口**动辄**几十上百个**操作**，**若**每个**操作**一个工具**，**则**光是**工具定义**就**吃掉**上下文**；**⭐ 而**代码模式的**做法**是**把**目录**留在**服务器**里**（**逐字**：**「**El catálogo nunca entra a tu contexto, solo entra lo que devuelvas.**」**）**，**让**模型**写一小段 **JavaScript**去**筛**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 一条硬规则：工具不替代理决定「哪一部分数据值得看」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**列出一条**项目级硬规则**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Dentro del código, cada operación devuelve su JSON completo**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一条**对 RIAA **最实用**：**⭐ 即**「**工具**该**返回**完整字段**、**由**调用方**按**自己的**目的**过滤**」**，**而**不**该**在**工具里**替**用户**决定**看**哪几列**；**⭐ 因为**「**该看哪几列**」**恰恰**取决于**业务问题**，**而**工具**作者**通常**不知道**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它指名修掉的一个真实缺陷：文本块里有保单、却读不到保单****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写道**：**「**El resumen en texto del modo clásico no traía la columna url, así que un agente podía encontrar una póliza y no tener nunca cómo leerla.**」**，**并逐字给出**原因**：**「**El bloque de texto es lo único que un modelo ve de una respuesta MCP; el structuredContent sobrevive solo para quien llama por programa.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这是**本轮**最具体的一处**工程教训**：**⭐ 即**协议层的**「**结构化内容**」**与**模型**实际**看得到**的东西**不**是**一回事**——**⭐ 而**一个**域接口**若**把**关键**的**定位信息**（**URL、**ID、**页码**）**只**放在**摘要文本**之外**，**就**会**出现**「**找得到、**读不到**」**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 覆盖范围与两种模式之外的实务细节（逐字可核）****——**⭐ 覆盖逐字包括**：**上市公司**（**按名称／**RUT／**代码检索、**IFRS 与 **NCH** 财务报表、**重大事实、**股东、**董事会、**处罚、**决议、**股东大会、**年报、**ESG 指标、**分红）**、**共同基金**（**3,400 只以上**的目录**）、**投资基金**、**经济指标**（**官方 **API v3**：**UF、**美元、**欧元、**TAB、**UTM、**IPC 等**）**、**监管规范**、**保险**（**逐字含**「**registro de depósito de pólizas**」**，**即**保单**存放登记**）**、**XBRL、**签署文件**与**银行系统**；**⭐ 另逐字提到** **BEST** 统计站点**（**逐字为 **5,180 个表**与 **34,023 条序列**）**；**⭐ 工程侧逐字**：**`registro.ts`** 从 **`src/tools/`** 派生**目录**、**`cmf-client.ts`** 做**中央 **HTTP 客户端**（**逐字含**白名单、**UA、**cookie、**限流、**重试）**、**`cache.ts`** 做 **LRU 与 **TTL****；**⭐ 限流逐字**为**对 **CMF** 每主机**每秒 1 次请求****；**⭐ 并逐字提示**其**签名链接**是**短暂的**（**逐字**：**「**no los comparta ni los trate como URLs permanentes**」**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cmf-chile]] 收录的是**该监管机构**自己的**统计入口****，**而**本条**是**第三方**把**同一机构**公开数据**做成**代理接口**；**[[apra-mcp]] 与 **[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 是**同一形态**（**监管数据 ＋ **MCP）在**其他辖区**的先例****——**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**本条**与 **[[cmf-chile]]** 的**关系**是**「**数据源**」与**「**接口**」**，**而**不**是**两个**数据源**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先数**工具**会**吃掉**多少**上下文**，**再**决定**暴露方式**；**② **返回**完整数据**、**把**过滤**留给**调用方**；**③ **把**定位信息**（**URL／ID**）**放进**模型**真能看到的**文本里**；**④ **限流**与**缓存**是**接口**的**一等公民**；**⑤ **用**公开数据**时**主动**写明**「**不**代表**该机构**」**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有连接**该 MCP 服务器**（**未取回**任何 **CMF** 数据、**未调用**任何工具）**，**故**不主张**其**任何操作**可用**、**也**不主张**其**数据**与**官方源**一致**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **TypeScript** 源码**；**⭐ 文中**两个**令牌数**（**37,000** 与 **736**）**为**作者**在 **README 中的**自述**，**⚠️ 本词条**如实转述**，**未**独立复现**。**③ ⚠️ 其**托管端点**（**逐字为 **`cmf-mcp.kumocloud.cl`）**本次**未**请求**，**故**其**在线可用性**未核实**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据**是否**有**延迟**、**是否**与**监管机构**官网**同步**。**⑤ ⚠️ 法律声明**逐字已标出**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**，**⚠️ 本词条**据此**提示**：**涉及金融决定**要**回到**官方源**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该服务器**是**接口**，**不是**投资建议**。

e.body_hk:
**MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一個**把**智利金融市場委員會**（CMF）**公開數據**接給 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 伺服器****——**逐字自述為**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一批操作、兩種暴露方式，令牌成本被實測出來****——**經典模式逐字**「**88 herramientas, una por operación**」**，**定義逐字**「**unos 37 mil tokens medidos**」**；**代碼模式**「**2 herramientas**」**、**逐字**「**un costo fijo de unos 736 tokens**」**，**並逐字總結**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos, y no crece si mañana hay 200 operaciones.**」**；**⭐ 即**把工具數量當上下文預算**——**代碼模式**把目錄**留在伺服器**（**逐字**El catálogo nunca entra a tu contexto, solo entra lo que devuelvas**）**，**讓模型**寫一小段 JavaScript 去篩**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 硬規則：工具不替代理決定「哪一部分數據值得看」****——**逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**，**並逐字說明**「**Dentro del código, cada operación devuelve su JSON completo**」**；**⭐ 即**工具返回完整欄位**、**由調用方**按**自己的目的**過濾**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它指名修掉的缺陷：文本塊裡有保單、卻讀不到保單****——**逐字**「**El resumen en texto del modo clásico no traía la columna url, así que un agente podía encontrar una póliza y no tener nunca cómo leerla.**」**，**並逐字給出原因**「**El bloque de texto es lo único que un modelo ve de una respuesta MCP; el structuredContent sobrevive solo para quien llama por programa.**」**；**⭐ 即**協議層的結構化內容**與**模型**實際看得到的東西**不**是**一回事**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 覆蓋與實務細節（逐字可核）****——**覆蓋逐字含**上市公司、**共同基金（**3,400 隻以上**）、**投資基金、**經濟指標（**官方 API v3**）、**監管規範、**保險**（**逐字含 registro de depósito de pólizas**）**、**XBRL、**簽署文件**與**銀行系統**，**另含 **BEST** 站點**（**逐字 5,180 個表**與 **34,023 條序列**）**；**工程側逐字**含 **`registro.ts`**、**`cmf-client.ts`**（**白名單、**UA、**cookie、**限流、**重試）**、**`cache.ts`**（**LRU 與 TTL**）**；**限流逐字**為**每主機每秒 1 次請求**；**簽名連結**逐字**「**no los comparta ni los trate como URLs permanentes**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cmf-chile]]、[[apra-mcp]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條**是**第三方**把**同一機構**公開數據**做成**代理接口**，**與 **[[cmf-chile]]** 的**關係**是**「**數據源**」與**「**接口**」**；**本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先數工具**吃掉多少上下文**；**② **返回完整數據、**過濾留給調用方**；**③ **把定位資訊放進模型真能看到的文本**；**④ **限流與緩存是一等公民**；**⑤ **用公開數據時**主動寫明**不代表該機構**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有連接**該 MCP 伺服器**，**不主張**其任何操作可用**；**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 TypeScript 源碼**；**⭐ 兩個令牌數（**37,000** 與 **736**）為**作者自述**，**本詞條**如實轉述而未獨立復現**；**③ ⚠️ 其託管端點**本次**未**請求**，**在線可用性**未核實**；**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其數據是否有延遲、**是否與官網同步**；**⑤ ⚠️ 法律聲明逐字已標出**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**，**涉及金融決定**要**回到官方源**；**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該伺服器是接口**，**不是**投資建議**。

e.body_en:
This is a model context protocol server that connects artificial-intelligence agents to the public data of the Chilean financial market regulator. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the same operations are exposed in two ways and the token cost of each is measured.** The description gives two endpoints: a classic mode with eighty-eight tools, one per operation, whose definitions are stated in writing to measure about thirty-seven thousand tokens, and a code mode with two tools at a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens, summarised in writing as ninety-eight percent less and constant even if there were two hundred operations tomorrow. **Treating the number of tools as a context budget is the single most transferable idea here, because a domain interface in insurance easily has dozens or hundreds of operations, and one tool per operation means the definitions alone consume the context. The code mode instead keeps the catalogue inside the server, stating in writing that the catalogue never enters the context and only what the caller returns does, and lets the model write a short piece of JavaScript to filter.**

**Second, a hard rule states that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen.** The description adds that inside the code path every operation returns its complete JSON. **The lesson is that a tool should return full fields and let the caller filter according to its own purpose, because which columns matter depends on the business question and the tool author usually does not know it.**

**Third, the project names the real defect it fixed: finding a policy without being able to read it.** The description states that the classic mode text summary carried no url column, so an agent could find a policy and never have a way to read it, and explains that the text block is the only part of a protocol response a model sees while structured content survives only for programmatic callers. **This is the most concrete engineering lesson of the round, because structured content at the protocol layer and what the model actually sees are two different things, and any domain interface that keeps the locating information such as a URL, an identifier, or a page number outside the summary text will produce lookups that cannot be followed.**

**Fourth, the coverage and the operational details are stated in writing.** Listed companies with search by name, tax identifier or ticker, financial statements, essential facts, shareholders, board, sanctions, resolutions, meetings, annual reports, environmental and social indicators and dividends; mutual funds with more than three thousand four hundred funds; investment funds; economic indicators through the official interface; regulation; insurance including the policy deposit registry; extensible business reporting language documents; signed documents; and banking systems, plus the regulator statistical site described as more than five thousand tables and more than thirty-four thousand series. **On the engineering side, the description names a registry module that derives the catalogue from the tool sources, a central client that handles the allowlist, user agent, cookies, rate limiting, and retries, and a cache module with least-recently-used eviction and time to live; the outward rate limit is stated as one request per second per host, and signed links are described as ephemeral and not to be shared or treated as permanent addresses.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: a pooled entry covers the regulator own statistics portal, **while this entry is a third-party agent interface over the same authority public data, and pooled entries already cover analogous regulator-data interfaces for other jurisdictions. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them, and states plainly that the relationship to the pooled portal entry is one of data source to interface rather than two data sources.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: count how much context the tools consume before choosing how to expose them; return complete data and leave filtering to the caller; put locating information into the text a model actually sees; treat rate limiting and caching as first-class parts of an interface; and state plainly when public data is used without any endorsement by the authority.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the server was neither installed nor connected**, no regulator data was retrieved and no tool was called, **so no claim is made that any operation works or that its data matches the official source**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the TypeScript source, and **the two token figures are the author own measurements transcribed here without independent reproduction**. **Third, its hosted endpoint was not requested this round**, so its online availability was not verified. **Fourth, whether its data lags the authority website was not verified. Fifth, the legal notice already states in writing that the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the regulator, and this entry therefore advises returning to the official source for financial decisions. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the server is an interface rather than investment advice.**
